items.q: What does your hoarding cleanout service involve?
a: Our hoarding cleanout services cover everything from removing clutter to hauling away furniture, appliances, and junk. We also provide hoarding decluttering with recycling and donations whenever possible, leaving the home clean and safe.

items.q: Are your staff trained to handle hoarding situations?
a: Yes. Our team is trained and experienced in hoarding junk removal and works with patience, respect, and discretion to make the process as comfortable as possible.

items.q: How long will a hoarding cleanout take?
a: Most hoarding cleanouts take a few hours to a full day, depending on the size of the property and the amount of clutter. Larger projects may take longer, but we work efficiently to complete them quickly.

items.q: Can I keep some of the items during a hoarding cleanout?
a: Of course. You are welcome to keep any belongings you want. Our hoarding cleanout companies work with you to make sure only unwanted items are removed.

items.q: Do you offer any emotional support during hoarding cleanouts?
a: Yes. We understand that hoarding cleanouts can be emotional. Our staff is patient, respectful, and supportive, helping you through the process step by step.
